name: HTTP 接口探测助手
description: 探测本机 localhost HTTP 接口：GET/HEAD、状态码、耗时与有界响应体预览，支持状态码与 JSON 字段断言，不跟随重定向、不走代理、绝不执行响应内容。

display_description.en: Probe localhost HTTP APIs with GET/HEAD: status, elapsed time, bounded body preview, status-code and JSON field assertions; redirects not followed.
display_description.zh: 探测本机 HTTP 接口：GET/HEAD 状态、耗时与响应预览，支持状态码与 JSON 字段断言。

default_init_input.zh: 探测 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health，断言返回 200 且 status 字段为 ok。
default_init_input.en: Probe http://127.0.0.1:8000/health, asserting status 200 and JSON field status=ok.

quick_inputs.zh: 探测 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health，断言返回 200 且 status 字段为 ok。
quick_inputs.en: Probe http://127.0.0.1:8000/health, asserting status 200 and JSON field status=ok.

quick_inputs.zh: 本地接口返回了什么？看看状态码、内容类型和响应体预览。
quick_inputs.en: What does this local endpoint return? Show status, content type and a body preview.

quick_inputs.zh: 验证 http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/items 返回的 JSON 字段是否符合预期。
quick_inputs.en: Verify the JSON fields returned by http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/items against expectations.

display_description.en: Localhost-only GET/HEAD prober with bounded body, status and JSON field assertions; never executes response content.
display_description.zh: 仅限本机的 GET/HEAD 探测：有界响应体、状态码与 JSON 字段断言，绝不执行响应内容。
